campaign.preview_disclaimer: Display simulation (not a guarantee of actual result)
theme.label: Theme:

wa.empty_accounts: No WhatsApp accounts connected yet. Link an account to start working.
wa.qr_instruction: Open WhatsApp on phone > Linked Devices > Link a Device > Scan QR:
wa.code_instruction: Open WhatsApp on phone > Linked Devices > Link with phone number > Enter code:
wa.err_already_linked: This number is already linked to another account
wa.notify_banned_msg: Your WhatsApp account has been temporarily restricted by WhatsApp.
wa.notify_stream_replaced_msg: Your WhatsApp account was connected from another location or session.
worker.withdraw_notice: Withdrawals are processed manually by admin. Balance will be deducted immediately upon submission.
worker.withdraw_success: Withdrawal request submitted successfully and queued.
worker.withdraw_currency_note: IDR withdrawals use IDR balance, USDT withdrawals use USDT balance after converting.
worker.convert_rate_lock_notice: Exchange rate is locked when you press confirm.
worker.referral_desc: Invite friends to work with GO BLAST. You will receive a bonus per message for every message successfully sent by your friends.
worker.referral_empty_list: No friends have joined via your link yet.
worker.wallet_not_set: Payout destination has not been configured yet.
worker.wallet_set_prompt: Save your payout account once for instant withdrawals without retyping.
worker.available_numbers_sub: Ready for broadcast across all active workers
worker.risk_banned_desc: WhatsApp may restrict or ban phone numbers if unnatural bulk sending activity is detected. We recommend using a backup number and setting a reasonable speed (slow/medium).
worker.risk_privacy_desc: The GO BLAST system only uses your WhatsApp session to deliver campaign messages. The system NEVER reads incoming replies, personal contacts, chat history, or status.
worker.risk_agree_checkbox: I have read, understand the number banning risks, and agree to these session privacy terms.
worker.speed_fast_warning: Warning: Fast speed carries a significantly higher risk of WhatsApp account bans. Use only if you fully understand this risk.
worker.referral_pending_notice: Referral bonus is automatically paid per successful message sent by your referred friend.
worker.history_desc: Records of messages you have successfully sent per campaign. Recipient phone numbers are never stored in your browser for privacy.
worker.history_no_data: No message sending history recorded yet.
worker.connected_accounts_sub: Accounts ready and active for work
admin.settings_desc: Manage operational parameters, sending delays, session limits, and wage rates.
admin.settings_daily_limit_warning: Warning: Without daily limits, workers' WhatsApp accounts are more easily banned by WhatsApp.
admin.freeze_reason_hint: Security recommendation for account takeover or fraud indication.
auth.agree_terms: I agree to the GO BLAST Terms and Conditions
auth.terms_required: You must agree to the Terms and Conditions to register.
admin.wallet_desc: Manage capital allocation and monitor remaining wallet balance (total top-up minus paid wages and referrals).
admin.workers_desc: Manage worker accounts, track active WhatsApp accounts, and total sent messages.
admin.workers_search_placeholder: Search worker by username or email...
admin.disable_confirm: Are you sure you want to disable this worker? All their WhatsApp accounts will be stopped and sessions cleared.
admin.withdrawals_desc: Manage worker payout queue and confirm transfers.
admin.withdraw_confirm_approve: Ensure you have transferred the funds to the worker account. Mark this withdrawal as completed?
admin.withdraw_confirm_reject: Reject this withdrawal request and refund balance to worker?
admin.search_placeholder: Search worker by username or email...
admin.campaign_delete_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete this campaign? All numbers inside will be removed.
campaign.delete_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete this campaign? All numbers inside will be removed.
campaign.err_delete_not_draft: Only draft campaigns can be deleted
campaign.err_delete_has_sent: Campaign with sent numbers cannot be deleted
campaign.err_delete_has_ledger: Campaign with ledger wage records cannot be deleted
campaign.archive_confirm: Archive this campaign? Archiving hides the campaign and makes it read-only. Number data remains stored on the server until manually cleaned in Storage.
campaign.purge_success: Campaign customer numbers successfully purged and anonymized.
campaign.err_purge_confirm_mismatch: Campaign name does not match confirmation.
campaign.err_purge_has_inflight: Cannot purge campaign while messages are being sent.
campaign.err_purge_rate_limit: Too many purge requests. Limit is 5 per hour.
storage.err_rate_limit: Too many cleanup actions. Limit is 5 per hour.
maintenance.title: System Under Maintenance
maintenance.desc: We are currently performing routine system maintenance for performance optimization and security. Worker services will resume shortly.
campaign.requeue_uncertain_warning: Attention: these numbers may have already received the message when the disruption occurred. Requeueing may send a duplicate message to the recipient. Proceed only if you are certain the message was not delivered.
campaign.requeue_uncertain_success: %d uncertain numbers were successfully requeued to available status.
campaign.native_warning_title: Experimental Mode Warning: Native Buttons (Native Flow)
campaign.native_warning_body: Native buttons mode uses WhatsApp built-in Interactive Messages. Based on spike testing, these buttons might not render on certain/older WhatsApp versions and are strictly limited to 20 recipients per campaign to mitigate sender ban risk.
campaign.native_agree_label: I understand and agree to the risks of using experimental native buttons mode (max 20 recipients).
campaign.native_must_agree: You must check the risk agreement before saving a campaign with experimental native buttons mode.
campaign.variable_warnings_hint: Numbers without variable data will be sent using fallback text (if any) or left blank.
backup.title: Database Backups & Restore
backup.desc: Encrypted backup of all sensitive data tables and uploads folder into .gbak file using AES-256-GCM.
backup.key_warning: WARNING: BACKUP_KEY and ENCRYPTION_KEY must have an off-site copy. Without them, backup files cannot be decrypted or restored.
backup.web_restore_disabled: Web restore is disabled for safety. Please use the CLI command 'goblast restore'.
backup.success_create: Database backup created and verified successfully.
backup.success_verify: Backup verification succeeded: all chunks, trailer, SHA-256, and tables match.
backup.err_delete_last: Cannot delete the last verified backup.
broadcast.manage_desc: Send rate update announcements, system maintenance, or critical info to worker dashboard.
broadcast.field_title_placeholder: e.g. Rate Update IDR and USDT
broadcast.field_message_placeholder: Write announcement details that will appear on worker dashboard banner...
broadcast.active_immediately: Activate immediately and display to workers
broadcast.delete_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete this broadcast?
ticket.manage_desc: List of support tickets and problem reports submitted by workers.
storage.title: Data Storage & Retention
storage.desc: Monitoring database disk space & system directories, plus safe idempotent manual cleanups.
storage.actions_desc: Each action displays preview of data volume to delete. Limited to 5 times per hour per admin.
storage.tmp_desc: Expired numbers upload preview files (> 1 hour).
storage.orphans_desc: Image files on server no longer attached to any campaign.
storage.retention_desc: Expired sessions, failed audits > 30 days, read notifications > 90 days.
storage.vacuum_desc: Run VACUUM ANALYZE on main tables (not FULL, no exclusive lock).
storage.campaigns_desc: Inactive campaigns. Customer numbers can be purged and anonymized to protect customer privacy.
storage.empty_campaigns: No archived or completed campaigns at this time.
maint.page_desc: Control system maintenance mode, database health, sender engine status, and audit activity logs.
maint.mode_desc_active: The system is currently under general maintenance. All worker panel pages are redirected to maintenance page and engine sending is automatically halted. Admin retains full access.
maint.mode_desc_inactive: System is operating normally. All workers can access panel, manage WhatsApp accounts, and request withdrawals.
maint.granular_desc: Lock specific features independently without shutting down whole worker panel. Workers navigating to these pages will see locked feature alert and admin message.
maint.lock_withdrawals_desc: Reject worker balance withdrawal requests and IDR to USDT conversion (lock_withdrawals).
maint.lock_linking_desc: Reject QR initialization and new WhatsApp account linking by workers (lock_linking).
maint.lock_engine_desc: Engine stops claiming new numbers, records system in maintenance, without disconnecting WA sessions (lock_engine).
maint.lock_msg_label: Special Message for Workers (Displayed in Worker Panel Alert Modal)
maint.lock_msg_placeholder: e.g. We are performing ledger synchronization. Withdrawals will reopen at 14:00.
maint.restrictions_desc: List of IPs and accounts temporarily restricted by anti brute-force rate limiter.
maint.empty_restrictions: No rate limit restrictions currently active.
